description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: King Ahasuerus of Persia holds a great banquet, and Queen Vashti refuses to come when called. The king removes her as queen.
1.sw: Mfalme Ahasuero wa Uajemi anafanya karamu kubwa, na Malkia Vashti anakataa kuja anapoitwa. Mfalme anamwondoa katika cheo cha malkia.
1.am: የፋርስ ንጉሥ አሕሻዊሮስ ታላቅ ግብዣ ያደርጋል፤ ንግሥት አስጢንም በተጠራች ጊዜ ለመምጣት እምቢ ትላለች። ንጉሡም ከንግሥትነቷ ይሽራታል።

2.en: Esther, a young Jewish woman raised by her cousin Mordecai, is chosen as queen without revealing her people. Mordecai uncovers a plot to kill the king.
2.sw: Esta, msichana Myahudi aliyelelewa na Mordekai, mtoto wa ami yake, anachaguliwa kuwa malkia bila kufunua watu wake. Mordekai anagundua njama ya kumuua mfalme.
2.am: የአጎቱ ልጅ መርዶክዮስ ያሳደጋት አይሁዳዊቷ ወጣት አስቴር ወገኗን ሳትገልጥ ንግሥት ሆና ትመረጣለች። መርዶክዮስ ንጉሡን ለመግደል የተደረገውን ሤራ ያጋልጣል።

3.en: Haman is promoted, and when Mordecai will not bow to him, Haman plans to destroy all the Jews. Lots are cast, and the king seals a decree for their destruction.
3.sw: Hamani anapandishwa cheo, na Mordekai anapokataa kumwinamia, Hamani anapanga kuwaangamiza Wayahudi wote. Kura zinapigwa, na mfalme anatia muhuri amri ya kuwaangamiza.
3.am: ሐማ ከፍ ያለ ማዕረግ ያገኛል፤ መርዶክዮስ እጅ ሊነሣው እምቢ ባለ ጊዜም ሐማ አይሁድን ሁሉ ለማጥፋት ያቅዳል። ዕጣ ይጣላል፤ ንጉሡም እንዲጠፉ የሚያዝዘውን ዐዋጅ ያትማል።

4.en: Mordecai mourns in sackcloth and urges Esther to plead with the king, saying she may have become queen for a time like this. Esther asks the Jews to fast for her and resolves to go to the king.
4.sw: Mordekai anaomboleza akiwa amevaa gunia na kumsihi Esta amwombe mfalme, akisema huenda amekuwa malkia kwa ajili ya saa kama hii. Esta anawaomba Wayahudi wafunge kwa ajili yake na kuamua kwenda kwa mfalme.
4.am: መርዶክዮስ ማቅ ለብሶ ያለቅሳል፤ አስቴርም ለእንደዚህ ያለ ጊዜ ንግሥት ሆና ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተናግሮ ንጉሡን እንድትለምን ያሳስባታል። አስቴር አይሁድ ስለ እርሷ እንዲጾሙ ትጠይቃለች፤ ወደ ንጉሡም ለመግባት ትወስናለች።

5.en: Esther goes to the king uninvited and is welcomed, and invites him and Haman to a banquet. Haman builds a gallows for Mordecai.
5.sw: Esta anakwenda kwa mfalme bila kualikwa na kukaribishwa, na kumwalika yeye na Hamani kwenye karamu. Hamani anasimamisha mti wa kunyongea kwa ajili ya Mordekai.
5.am: አስቴር ሳትጠራ ወደ ንጉሡ ትገባለች፤ በደስታም ትቀበላለች፤ እርሱንና ሐማን ወደ ግብዣ ትጠራቸዋለች። ሐማ ለመርዶክዮስ መስቀያ እንጨት ያቆማል።

6.en: Unable to sleep, the king learns that Mordecai was never honored for saving him. Haman, coming to ask for Mordecai's death, is made to honor Mordecai through the city.
6.sw: Mfalme, akikosa usingizi, anajua kwamba Mordekai hakuwahi kuheshimiwa kwa kumwokoa. Hamani, anayekuja kuomba Mordekai auawe, analazimishwa kumheshimu Mordekai katika mji wote.
6.am: እንቅልፍ ያጣው ንጉሥ መርዶክዮስ እርሱን ስላዳነው ምንም ክብር እንዳልተሰጠው ያውቃል። የመርዶክዮስን ሞት ሊለምን የመጣው ሐማ በከተማዪቱ ሁሉ መርዶክዮስን እንዲያከብር ይገደዳል።

7.en: At the second banquet Esther reveals Haman's plot against her people. Haman is hanged on the gallows he built for Mordecai.
7.sw: Katika karamu ya pili Esta anafunua njama ya Hamani dhidi ya watu wake. Hamani anatundikwa juu ya mti wa kunyongea aliousimamisha kwa ajili ya Mordekai.
7.am: በሁለተኛው ግብዣ አስቴር ሐማ በወገኗ ላይ ያሤረውን ትገልጣለች። ሐማ ለመርዶክዮስ ባቆመው መስቀያ እንጨት ላይ ይሰቀላል።

8.en: Esther pleads for her people, and a new decree allows the Jews to defend themselves. Mordecai is honored, and the Jews celebrate.
8.sw: Esta anawaombea watu wake, na amri mpya inawaruhusu Wayahudi kujitetea. Mordekai anaheshimiwa, na Wayahudi wanasherehekea.
8.am: አስቴር ስለ ወገኗ ትለምናለች፤ አዲስ ዐዋጅም አይሁድ ራሳቸውን እንዲከላከሉ ይፈቅዳል። መርዶክዮስ ይከበራል፤ አይሁድም ደስ ይላቸዋል።

9.en: The Jews defeat their enemies on the appointed day, and Haman's sons are killed. The festival of Purim is established to remember the deliverance.
9.sw: Wayahudi wanawashinda adui zao siku iliyowekwa, na wana wa Hamani wanauawa. Sikukuu ya Purimu inawekwa ili kukumbuka wokovu huo.
9.am: አይሁድ በተወሰነው ቀን ጠላቶቻቸውን ድል ያደርጋሉ፤ የሐማ ልጆችም ይገደላሉ። ያንን መዳን ለማሰብ የፉሪም በዓል ይመሠረታል።

10.en: Mordecai is second only to the king and works for the good of his people.
10.sw: Mordekai anakuwa wa pili baada ya mfalme na kuyatafutia watu wake mema.
10.am: መርዶክዮስ ከንጉሡ ቀጥሎ ሁለተኛ ይሆናል፤ ለወገኑም መልካም ነገርን ይሠራል።
